title: Case 012: Accepted Renewal

details.broker: Ternwick Brokers, represented by Katie Vale

initial_request: I have reviewed renewal offer INS-012 for my property at 112 Ash Walk, Brackenford, ZZ2 3ZZ, and I accept it. Please pass my acceptance to the insurer and let me know when it confirms the renewal.
overview: Katie Vale sent Finn Morton the renewal offer for his property. Finn accepted offer INS-012 by email, and Katie forwarded his acceptance to Westmere General Insurance. The insurer replied confirming the renewal for the 12-month period stated in the offer; Katie relayed that confirmation to Finn, who acknowledged receiving it.

next_action.summary: At the escalation point, Katie was to send Finn’s acceptance of offer INS-012 to Westmere General Insurance before the offer deadline; she did so by email.

outcome: Westmere General Insurance confirmed the renewal for the 12-month period stated in offer INS-012.

events.body: Westmere General Insurance's renewal offer INS-012 for 112 Ash Walk, Brackenford, ZZ2 3ZZ covers 1 June 2025 to 31 May 2026: annual premium £540.00, buildings limit £275,000 for fire, storm and sudden escape of water, £250 standard excess per covered event; other existing terms remain unchanged. Please reply by 20 May 2025 if you wish to accept; it is not renewed merely because we sent this offer.
I have reviewed offer INS-012 for 1 June 2025 to 31 May 2026 at £540.00 and accept the renewal as presented. Please pass my acceptance to Westmere General Insurance.
Finn Morton has accepted renewal offer INS-012 for 112 Ash Walk, Brackenford, ZZ2 3ZZ. Please confirm the renewal and the period that will apply.

We confirm the renewal under offer INS-012 for 1 June 2025 to 31 May 2026 at £540.00 for the year, on the stated limit, excess and otherwise unchanged terms. Please advise Finn Morton of this confirmation.
Westmere General Insurance has confirmed the renewal under offer INS-012 for 1 June 2025 to 31 May 2026 at £540.00 on the offered terms. I’m passing on the insurer’s confirmation.
Received, thank you. I understand that the insurer has confirmed the renewal for the period stated in the offer.
